title: Metacognitive Reasoning in Energy Based Models using Instance Based Learning Theory
abstract: arXiv:2610.00399v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Metacognition involves reasoning about cognitive processes themselves. An example is in resource allocation where we choose how much time and effort to put into a reasoning task before we begin based on our confidence. Current Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems that rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) cannot estimate their uncertainty about an output without first responding, and cannot dynamically allocate resources to producing an output, making this type of metacognitive process difficult. A recently proposed alternative to classic transformer architectures that addresses these two concerns is the Energy Based Model (EBM) which allows for interpretable uncertainty modeling and dynamic allocation of compute resources. While EBMs can allow for control of these two processes, the actual metacognitive task of determining compute allocation based on uncertainty is not directly addressed. translated_title: 基于实例学习理论的能量模型中的元认知推理
translated_abstract: 元认知涉及对认知过程本身的推理。一个典型的例子是资源分配：我们在开始一项推理任务之前，会基于自身的信心来决定投入多少时间和精力。当前依赖大语言模型（LLM）的人工智能（AI）系统无法在不先给出回答的情况下估计其对输出的不确定性，也无法动态分配资源来生成输出，这使得这类元认知过程难以实现。最近提出的一种可替代经典Transformer架构的方案是能量模型（EBM），它支持可解释的不确定性建模以及计算资源的动态分配。然而，尽管EBM能够对这两个过程加以控制，但基于不确定性来决定计算分配这一实际的元认知任务本身并未被直接解决。实例学习理论（IBLT）提供了一个（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将实例学习理论（IBLT）引入能量模型（EBM），使其能够基于不确定性估计进行元认知式的计算资源动态分配，从而弥补大语言模型无法在作答前评估不确定性、无法灵活分配算力的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper applies Instance-Based Learning Theory (IBLT) to Energy-Based Models (EBMs) to enable metacognitive reasoning—dynamically allocating compute resources based on uncertainty estimates—addressing key limitations of LLM-based AI systems.
